brief.ask: Create a brand identity for Quillnest, the writing app in this folder.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: encouraging and a little bold, for 13–17 year-olds, never childish or school-like. No owls, no pencils or quills drawn literally, no lightbulbs, no speech bubbles. App icon for iOS and Android plus a web version.

claim.notes: Üç yönden hiçbiri kalite kapısını geçemedi (en iyisi q-nest, ortalama 6.08 < 6.5; marka uyumu, ayırt edicilik ve akılda kalıcılık 5), bu yüzden finalize, export, install-assets planı ve galeri yapılmadı.

concepts.title: Insert Mark
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s5 slanted tag or eye; s6 face or mouth with teeth; s7 rock or Pac-Man-like bite; s8 letter C or E bracket with a dot (initial-like, plug/face risk). s1-s4 earlier struck. Several read as faces or a different letter, and none says writing or editing at a glance; the dot-in-bite device repeats across the board. Direction dropped.

concepts.title: Next Step
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s5 bent pipe or quarter-arc; s6 leaf with hole (nature/eco cliché); s7 letter S or squiggle; s8 peanut or gourd blob. s1-s4 already struck (split or nested square, ramp). The gold launch accent that carried the idea is gone from s5-s8, and what is left is generic geometry, with s5 the best but a plain pipe bend. No form carries 'next step' or writing. Direction dropped.

concepts.title: Q Nest
readsAs: Q-shaped helmet or bowl-cut face with a single orange eye
a fishbowl or bowl with an egg/yolk
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 a user/avatar icon (head over open shoulders); s2 a smiley or avatar; s3 a target or wifi/eye; s4 a heavy serif Q with a dot, the only one that reads as the letter first; s5 magnifier or loading spinner. Keep s4: the heavy Q with the egg in the counter. Fix: separate egg and Q with a gap (one-colour merge warning), make the tail a real nest cradle instead of a stock swash, and keep the coral small so the mark stays blue-led. Risk: generic Q plus a dot if the tail does not become ownable.
